subject: Re: HelioHealth - EU data residency + support access details
body:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Kovacs <nina.kovacs@heliohealth.example>
Cc: HelioHealth Security <security@heliohealth.example>
Date: Mon, Oct 7, 2024 at 10:09 AM
Subject: Re: HelioHealth - EU data residency + support access details

Hi Nina,

On data residency: we can serve and store operational data for HelioHealth in EU (eu-west). For troubleshooting, some Redwood support engineers are outside the EU (including APAC).

We can support an audited break-glass process where non-EU personnel may access *audit logs and request metadata* (request ids, timestamps, model, status codes) through RBAC-controlled console tooling. We do not enable prompt/response payload logging for your tenant.

If acceptable, well document this as a time-bounded exception with controls.

Best,
Evelyn


From: Nina Kovacs <nina.kovacs@heliohealth.example>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Oct 8, 2024 at 2:31 PM
Subject: Re: HelioHealth - EU data residency + support access details

Thanks. We need explicit confirmation: no prompts/responses stored, break-glass access is time-limited + logged.


From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Kovacs <nina.kovacs@heliohealth.example>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 10, 2024 at 5:58 PM
Subject: Re: HelioHealth - EU data residency + support access details

Confirmed. For HelioHealth: prompt/response payload logging is disabled. Break-glass access is time-limited and recorded in audit logs. Well proceed with the documented exception covering non-EU support personnel access to operational metadata only.
